name: comic-text

frames.best_why: The word sits level at full size with the halftone fill and layered shadow fully visible.

tagline: A comic-book shout in dotted yellow with a heavy black outline.
summary: A single word rendered as a loud comic-book caption, in yellow halftone letters with a thick black outline, red and black drop shadows and a slight lean, popping in on a spring.
appearance: The word KABOOM! fills the middle of a black stage in chunky uppercase comic lettering. The letters are yellow filled with fine red dots, edged in heavy black, cast with an offset black shadow plus a thin red one, and tilted slightly to the right.
behaviour: The word springs in from a little smaller and tilted, overshoots slightly and settles upright, then holds still.
demo_content: The word KABOOM! in comic-book lettering.
use_when: A playful banner or game screen wants a loud comic-book shout.
avoid_when: Serious or dense interfaces; the halftone and thick outline are very loud.
customise: Pass the word as children and set fontSize or override style; the yellow and red palette, halftone dots, outline and skew are hardcoded in the source.
weight_why: One text element with a single entrance spring, static afterwards.

a11y.note: The word is real readable text, but the entrance spring never checks reduced-motion.

polish_why: Convincing comic styling with layered shadows and halftone; the demo shows only one word.
